newsitem.title: POLAND: PPWK rights first leg 97 pct subscribed.
newsitem.headline: PPWK rights first leg 97 pct subscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 855,588 shares of Polish map maker Polskie Przedsiebiorstwo Wydawnictw Kartograficznych SA (PPWK) in the first leg of its 885,534 one-for-two rights issue, the company said in a statement.

The company, listed on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, earlier said that if not all the shares, priced at 12 zlotys each, were subscribed for in the first leg, the leftover stock would be offered from November 4 to November 18.

The issue is being underwritten by Petrobank and Eastbrokers Warszawski Dom Maklerski SA brokerage, which agreed to underwrite 175,000 and 125,000 shares respectively for a fee of two percent of the value of underwritten shares.
